evidence: next weekly review 09-28 13:00Z; its window is [(review - 7d), review]. Below it Growth::GateRead returns :extend ("re-read, do NOT act") regardless of the date, so the pre-registered GO/PIVOT/KILL read is deferred by arithmetic, not by waiting. Render loop: 9 refusal(s) in the last 12h, so no new post-intervention photo can enter the pool -- the cohort is fed only by renders (publication lags them by the queue depth). That is why a GPU refusal starves the STRATEGY decision and not merely a render window; the launch-args gate is NOT firing (no :8188 instance is up without --reserve-vram), so the refusal is the VRAM/claim path -- check_render_starved carries that attribution and this entry deliberately does not guess a holder. Nothing here is ours to repair -- the refusal itself is correct (an instance launched without --reserve-vram cannot be submitted to) -- and this entry is not an ask on the holder: it self-closes when the loop stops being refused.
